extendedinputbox-desc: Adds advanced dialog-based forms on top of InputBox
extendedinputbox-error-unresolved-title: The generated page title still contains unresolved braces: $1. Check the "page=" parameter of the <inputbox> configuration.
extendedinputbox-error-preload-fetch: Could not retrieve the preload template "$1". The page was not published. Check that this template exists and try again.
extendedinputbox-error-popup-preload-dep: Error: the "popup-preload" parameter is no longer supported. Please use "preload" instead.
extendedinputbox-error-invalid-bgcolor: Error: the value of "button-bgcolor" is not a valid CSS color.
extendedinputbox-error-invalid-bordercol: Error: the value of "button-border-color" is not a valid CSS color.
extendedinputbox-error-duplicate-field: Error: the field name "$1" is used more than once in this form.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-intro: Visually build an <inputbox> form, then insert the generated wikitext into a target page, preview it and publish it.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-field-skipe: Publish directly, without the edit screen (skip-edit=yes)
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-no-fields: No fields yet. Click "Add a field" to start.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-notice-newp: This page does not exist yet. It will be created when you publish.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-notice-inse: Wikitext inserted at the cursor position.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-error-notit: Please enter a valid page title.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-error-noedi: You do not have the necessary rights to edit this page.
You do not have the necessary rights to edit this page: $1
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-error-editc: An edit conflict was detected: the page was edited by someone else since it was loaded. Click "Load page" again, then reapply your changes before publishing.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-error-copy-: Copy failed. Please select the text manually.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-warning-inc: Field #$1 has no name and/or label: it will not be included in the generated wikitext.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-error-noins: Please load a target page first.
extendedinputbox-formbuilder-confirm-ove: This page already exists. Do you want to overwrite it with your changes?
